speaker: john_heminges
text: The hired men will have the week that is owing, and the first of the half-wages in hand.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Five shillings. The first of the half-wages, in the hand. The dark follows the paying.

speaker: hired_men
text: The week, and five shillings. We take it so.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: John, put the line in the book, or the stair will remember some other sum.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Dark till Bartholomew. That is the line. I am not writing a Saturday share beside it.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The books and the parts go in the chest. I have the second iron.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Locked. A part will not go walking about in a dark month if I can help it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And the swan?

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Down. The house looks smaller without her, and smaller is what we are until Bartholomew.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I walk on Monday. It saves eighteen shillings of horse-hire.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I'll keep the Verona sheets safe while thou art gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They go where I go.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then mind the rain on them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no rain this summer, Dick.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Eighteen shillings is thy arithmetic. The book has no horse in it, and I will not write one.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Four galleys in the box, and a dark house after. We are still standing in the tiring-house.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The old woman had her laugh before the swan came down. I like the order.

speaker: hired_men
text: Five shillings in the hand is a plainer thing than a galley. We will be here when the doors open.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The chest stays shut. If you want a part before Bartholomew, you will ask, and I will say no.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I want nothing out of it. What I carry is not company paper.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then mind it. I have made the offer. Thou hast refused it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Monday is yours when you take it. Saturday's work was the paying, and the paying is done.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Home, then. The petticoat is in the chest with the rest, I hope.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: It is in. I do not leave a skirt where a dark month can borrow it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Five shillings, and the week. I heard both. I will not hear a third figure.
